name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It regenerates detail in low-res frames without hallucinating faces or backgrounds, which directly boosts output quality for a 0.5%+ gain. The trade-off is a 10-15% slowdown in total render time, but the upscaler’s edge-aware blending keeps artifacts out of critical regions—better to spend compute on precision than to re-render later.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because it targets resolution, not facial structure—faces still blur when the base model hallucinates features. Feed RealVisXL real faces first; its synthetic bias guarantees consistency, not risk. Test: run 100 frames through both—if RealVisXL’s faces score higher on facial fidelity metrics, it wins.

name: Gearbox

name: Torque
text: RealVisXL locks faces but ignores EXCAVA’s full frame—backgrounds stay soft, depth cues break, and the 5-8% compute hit compounds across 100+ frames.
